From 247f2ee4498cfcaf18b3c3486dffd2302d56fc17 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Thomas=20Hellstr=C3=B6m?= <thomas.hellstrom@linux.intel.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Feb 2024 11:38:33 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] drm/xe: Fix a missing argument to drm_err_printer
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

The indicated commit below added a device argument to the
function, but there was a call in the xe driver that was
not properly changed.

Fixes: 5e0c04c8c40b ("drm/print: make drm_err_printer() device specific by using drm_err()")
Cc: Jani Nikula <jani.nikula@intel.com>
Cc: Luca Coelho <luciano.coelho@intel.com>
Cc: Maxime Ripard <mripard@kernel.org>
Signed-off-by: Thomas Hellström <thomas.hellstrom@linux.intel.com>
Acked-by: Maxime Ripard <mripard@kernel.org>
Reviewed-by: Jani Nikula <jani.nikula@intel.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20240212103833.138263-1-thomas.hellstrom@linux.intel.com

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/xe/xe_gt_tlb_invalidation.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/xe/xe_gt_tlb_invalidation.c
index 7eef23a00d77..d42645fdfc02 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/xe/xe_gt_tlb_invalidation.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/xe/xe_gt_tlb_invalidation.c
@@ -314,7 +314,7 @@ int xe_gt_tlb_invalidation_wait(struct xe_gt *gt, int seqno)
 {
 	struct xe_device *xe = gt_to_xe(gt);
 	struct xe_guc *guc = &gt->uc.guc;
-	struct drm_printer p = drm_err_printer(__func__);
+	struct drm_printer p = drm_err_printer(&xe->drm, __func__);
 	int ret;
 
 	/*
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/xe/xe_gt_tlb_invalidation.c`**
   - The line initializing the `drm_printer` object was modified. 
   - Changed from:
     ```c
     struct drm_printer p = drm_err_printer(__func__);
     ```
     to:
     ```c
     struct drm_printer p = drm_err_printer(&xe->drm, __func__);
     ```
   - This change adds a device argument (`&xe->drm`) to the `drm_err_printer` function call, making the error printing device-specific.

### Relationships

- The modification in `xe_gt_tlb_invalidation.c` addresses a bug introduced by a previous commit (`5e0c04c8c40b`) that made the `drm_err_printer` function device-specific. The patch corrects the function call in the xe driver to include the necessary device argument, ensuring that error messages are properly associated with the specific device instance. This change is crucial for maintaining accurate error reporting in the driver.

drm/xe: Fix a missing argument to drm_err_printer
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

The indicated commit below added a device argument to the
function, but there was a call in the xe driver that was
not properly changed.

Fixes: 5e0c04c8c40b ("drm/print: make drm_err_printer() device specific by using drm_err()")
Cc: Jani Nikula <jani.nikula@intel.com>
Cc: Luca Coelho <luciano.coelho@intel.com>
Cc: Maxime Ripard <mripard@kernel.org>
Signed-off-by: Thomas Hellström <thomas.hellstrom@linux.intel.com>
Acked-by: Maxime Ripard <mripard@kernel.org>
Reviewed-by: Jani Nikula <jani.nikula@intel.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20240212103833.138263-1-thomas.hellstrom@linux.intel.com

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by a previous commit that modified the `drm_err_printer` function to require a device argument, but the call in the `xe_gt_tlb_invalidation.c` file was not updated accordingly. This oversight resulted in the error printer not being device-specific, which could lead to incorrect or ambiguous error messages being logged.

Here is the patch:
  */
 int xe_gt_tlb_invalidation_wait(struct xe_gt *gt, int seqno)
 {
 	struct xe_device *xe = gt_to_xe(gt);
 	struct xe_guc *guc = &gt->uc.guc;
-	struct drm_printer p = drm_err_printer(__func__);
+	struct drm_printer p = drm_err_printer(&xe->drm, __func__);
 	int ret;
 
 	/*
 	 * XXX: See above, this algorithm only works if seqno are always in
 	 * order
 	 */
 	ret = wait_event_timeout(guc->ct.wq,
 				 tlb_invalidation_seqno_past(gt, seqno),
 				 TLB_TIMEOUT);
 	if (!ret) {
 		drm_err(&xe->drm, "gt%d: TLB invalidation time'd out, seqno=%d, recv=%d\n",
 			gt->info.id, seqno, gt->tlb_invalidation.seqno_recv);
 		xe_guc_ct_print(&guc->ct, &p, true);
 		return -ETIME;
 	}
 
 	return 0;
 }

The `drm_err_printer` function was modified to require a device argument, but the call in the `xe_gt_tlb_invalidation_wait` function did not provide the necessary device context. This oversight resulted in the error printer not being device-specific, leading to potentially incorrect or ambiguous error messages.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c

```
